acceptance.G1: Complete relevant Rust/contracts, Clippy, minimal build, UI check/build/unit tests and real-core browser suite pass; no known critical unresolved failure.
acceptance.G2: All full-curriculum cases correct and admitted, including grouping, weighted calculation, histogram, actual 600-row CSV, all three old recurrence classes and all three new state/order classes; independently audit actual results.
acceptance.G3: Freeze source-only number, candidate, data and evaluator before reserved execution. All 768 inherited future outputs and 48 input-set replicates correct, in every new class; no future labels in learner payload.
acceptance.G4: Matched no-library control receives the same number, examples, future inputs and total caps, with only library use removed; inherited solves strictly more classes/cases. All costs and failures retained.
acceptance.G5: Retain all previous 40 procedures and v1 development extensions, 7400 structural cases, 3100 dialogue turns, selective dependency invalidation and relearning under the larger catalogue without raising per-acquisition caps.
acceptance.G6: Independent process born only from full compiled number: all 384 new portable outputs correct, without parent examples/cache/teacher. Prior portable evidence stays attributed to its actual version.
acceptance.G7: Measure source and full teaching/control processes, birth and executable/seed sizes; include initialization, window changes and inquiry in logged work and physical process scope. Respect fixed wall/RAM/seed caps. Energy and historical research costs unavailable, not zero; no cold-inference or universal efficiency claim.
acceptance.G8: Type/domain/fuel limits, invalid inputs, callback cancellation, independent admission, atomic publication, context identities, dependencies and effects validated; no candidate access to external files, evaluator labels or additional authority.
acceptance.G9: Actual SHA256 identities, prospective data manifest, independent arithmetic/array audit, immutable negative and positive receipts; no tuning on the new reserve. If it fails, keep M0 open.
acceptance.G10: Real-core UI run/export with no gaps, query selection preceding its answer, bounded evidence restoration, honest historical/live states, unknown metrics unavailable, mobile/accessibility checks. Record any existing persistent server loaded-code limitations.

freeze_rule: Before reserve create a new manifest with actual candidate, source-only number, compiled source, data, evaluator, reference and this protocol identities. Validate absence of target rules in the source-only seed and exact reproduction by birth.
failure_rule: A failed required gate leaves M0 open. Never drop an old integrated failure or relabel a consumed family as fresh to approve this revision.
promotion_rule: Only all G1--G10 with verified receipts can validate M0 in this bounded operational scope. Broader objectives and M1--M10 remain unachieved until their own evidence exists.
